name: Audit a design script
description: run a design script and say whether its oligos were derived with C6 or typed by hand — re-deriving each anneal from its own 3' end, naming any that is not in the template it claims, listing hand-written sequences and imports from outside C6, and counting what was never checked at all
phrases: was this oligo designed with the tools
check a design before I order oligos

requires.note: runs the script, collects both audits, exits 1 on a hard finding
the two checks — one over the script's text, one over an actual anneal
what a design script looks like when it is done right

returns: a report per oligo — checked, not in its template, or unchecked — with the tool's alternative beside any anneal it would have improved on; exit 1 on a hard finding

examples.output: 2 oligo(s): 2 checked, 0 not in their template, 0 unchecked
3 oligo(s): 1 checked, 1 not in their template, 1 unchecked

notes:
HARD FINDINGS FAIL THE RUN: an import from outside C6, and an anneal that is not in the template it names. Everything else is ADVISORY and exits 0 — a hand-typed sequence may be a cut site, and a lower-scoring anneal may have had a reason, so the tool's alternative is printed beside it rather than substituted for it.

UNDECLARED IS NOT VERIFIED. An oligo carrying no `template` is counted and named as UNCHECKED. A design whose oligos all lack templates produces a report with no findings and has been checked for nothing, and a reader who cannot tell that from a clean design has been misled by this command rather than informed by it.

IT CANNOT SEE A VALUE COMPUTED CORRECTLY FOR THE WRONG REASON. The text half reads text; the value half checks one anneal against the tool's choice for the same 3' end. Neither knows whether the design is a good idea.
